headers.comment: Shared ES modules change only on deploy. Without an explicit header Vercel revalidates them on every navigation, so each page load pays a round trip per module before any Firestore call can start. must-revalidate keeps them correct: the browser reuses the file for an hour, then checks.

Images are content-stable. logo-transparent.png in particular is now referenced by trade-detail.html and the monthly report instead of being inlined, so it should be fetched once and reused across pages.
HTML must NOT be cached hard. These files carry the app logic inline, so a stale copy is a stale app — this is the exact failure mode behind several 'the fix didn't work' rounds. Always revalidate.
